mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as valuations adjust to lower cost of capital.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day SPX returns is negative or average 20-day return when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months or Rank IC for the signal is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.3% over one month signals contraction in manufacturing and construction sectors, reducing corporate output capacity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: Rank IC for the joint decline signal is negative or average 20-day return when both series decline > 0.3% in 1 month is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 215.0), a rising CPIAUCSL signals central bank rate hike expectations that increase equity discount rates, reducing valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day return when CPIAUCSL > 215.0 and rises in 1 month is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or Rank IC for the signal is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction demand, signaling economic expansion and corporate revenue growth that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST as predictor of 5-day SPX returns is negative or average 5-day return when HOUST > 1000 is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60-day return when INDPRO < 100.0 is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or Rank IC for the signal is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0) and weak employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.1% in 1 month) signals labor market stress, reducing consumer spending power and corporate revenue, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS growth < 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: Rank IC for the joint signal is negative or average 20-day return when both conditions hold is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary demand contraction (RSAFS < 370000), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals reduced consumer spending, directly lowering corporate revenue and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5-day return when RSAFS < 370000 is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or Rank IC for the signal is < 0.03.
